titleStmt.title: Organization of the Constituent National Assembly and decree issued by the same under dat of to-day.

head.hi: Organization of the Constituent National Assembly and decree issued by the same under dat of to-day.

div.p: We, who have been chosen representatives in the constituent assembly of the Republic of Guatemala, which was convoked by a decree of the 26th of June last, having met in sufficient numbers, having examined our respective credentials, and having found the same to be in the form required by law,
Do hereby declare that the National Constituent Assembly is formally organized in the name of the nation.
Let this be communicated to the executive for publication. Done at the hall of sessions, in Guatemala, this first day of October, one thousand eight hundred and eighty-seven.
